q1.explanationZh: 男孩说他改到了下周六，也就是 23 号（that’s the 23rd）。A 错：他本想这周六（16 号）办，但爸爸出差了；B 错：20 号是他的生日，派对不在那天。

q2.explanationZh: 女孩说今天的比赛 3 点半才开始（we aren’t playing till half past three）。A 错：2 点半是他们说话的时间；B 错：3 点 15 分是老师到的时间。

q3.explanationZh: 妈妈问是不是正面有狮子的那件，男孩说他指的是另一件，有滑板图案的。A 错：月亮图案的 T 恤只是在它旁边；C 错：狮子图案的不是他想要的。

q4.explanationZh: 男孩问是不是 6.50 英镑（six pounds fifty, right?），女孩说对。C 错：8.75 英镑是演出当天买票的价格；A 错：2.25 英镑是当天买要多付的钱。

q5.explanationZh: 男孩说很高兴和同学 Ben 一起度过时光，所以昨晚一起吃饭的是同龄的男孩 Ben。B 错：饭后来接 Ben 的是他爷爷，爷爷没有一起吃饭；A 错：妈妈只是问来接的是不是 Ben 的爸爸。

q6.explanationZh: 老师说有几个人想去河边，但森林更受欢迎，而且以前没去过，所以去森林（the forest）。river 是干扰项。

q7.explanationZh: 老师说大巴 8:45 出发，请大家最晚 8:35 到校（no later than 8:35）。8:45 是发车时间，不是到校时间。

q8.explanationZh: 老师说你们需要一件外套保暖（You’ll need a coat to keep warm）。穿短裤（shorts）会太冷，是干扰项。

q9.explanationZh: 向导叫 Dan Pilsey，老师逐个字母拼出了 P-I-L-S-E-Y，要注意拼写正确。

q10.explanationZh: 老师让大家试着找生活在那里的马（try to find some of the horses）。向导拍过关于猴子的电影，但那里看不到猴子，所以不填 monkeys。

q11.explanationZh: 男孩说他爸爸在杂志上看到了广告，告诉他应该参加，所以是爸爸告诉他的。B 错：看到广告的是爸爸，不是男孩；C 错：是女孩从老师那里知道的。

q12.explanationZh: 男孩说和其他棋手在一起是最好的事，女孩回答 True（对），两人都同意。A 错：男孩说只有赢了比赛才有趣，而他从没赢过；B 错：只有男孩夸了教练。

q13.explanationZh: 女孩说上周她去医院看奶奶了，即她要去看望别人。A 错：奶奶今晚帮她写历史作业，不是上周没去的原因；C 错：头疼的是奶奶，不是女孩。

q14.explanationZh: 男孩想拍团队合影，但很遗憾把手机落在家里了（unfortunately I left my mobile at home），所以没能拍照很遗憾。B 错：他输了，但说比赛很好，并不生气；C 错：他是错过公交车走回家的，不是走去俱乐部。

q15.explanationZh: 男孩提议踢球前一起去购物中心的咖啡馆吃三明治（let’s have a sandwich），女孩同意，即一起吃点东西。A 错：男孩要踢足球，不能去看电影；C 错：咖啡馆在购物中心，但他们不去购物。

q16.explanationZh: 女孩说如果男孩不忙，她想喝点果汁（I’d love some juice），即想让他拿点喝的。A 错：她只是让男孩把手机递给她，用来检查拼写，不是打电话；C 错：她说作业不难，不用帮忙。

q17.explanationZh: 老师说她有时做练习花的时间太长（it takes you a bit too long to finish an exercise），所以以后要做得快一些。A 错：她的作业总是按时完成；C 错：老师夸她讨论时总能说出有趣的观点。

q18.explanationZh: 女孩说那是最后一个，而且折扣很大（the discount was great），她是因为价格买的。A 错：她本来不太确定要不要绿色的；B 错：包有点小，装不下她的书。

q19.explanationZh: 女孩说她买了夹克以后长高了，很快穿起来就像借了妹妹的衣服，即夹克不够大了。B 错：妈妈提到口袋很小，但女孩没说这是原因；C 错：她喜欢这个颜色，还想买同样颜色的新夹克。

q20.explanationZh: 男孩说他画了地图，很有趣，而且画得很好让他很自豪，所以他最喜欢画地图。A 错：他说看视频还可以（That was OK）；C 错：上网查资料的是其他同学。

q21.explanationZh: 男孩说 Angela 是乐队成员，整个周末都在排练（she practised all weekend），即演奏音乐。F 错：他们只是在一家商店楼上的房间排练，并没有购物。

q22.explanationZh: Marvin 这周末去爷爷奶奶家住了（went away to stay with his granny and grandad）。G 错：他平时周末去游泳，但这周末没去成。

q23.explanationZh: Diane 要给爸爸挑生日礼物，所以去了百货商店，即去购物。A 错：她想买些烹饪用品给爸爸，自己并没有做饭。

q24.explanationZh: Gavin 参观了一座 14 世纪建造的城堡，即去看了一座古老的建筑。E 错：那里正好有免费的爵士音乐会，但他只是听，没有演奏。

q25.explanationZh: Lucy 的奶奶想下国际象棋，于是她们下了整个周末。国际象棋（chess）是一种棋类游戏（board game）。G 错：Lucy 想去游泳，但没去成。

content.v: Test One. There are five parts to the test. You will hear each piece twice. We will now stop for a moment. Please ask any questions now because you must NOT speak during the test.
Now look at the instructions for Part One.
For each question, choose the correct answer. Look at question one.
One. When is the party?
Are you coming to my birthday party?
Yeah, when is it?
I wanted to have it this Saturday – the 16th – but my dad’s away for work. So I chose next Saturday instead – that’s the 23rd. My birthday’s actually on the 20th but I don’t mind.
Great! Can’t wait.
Two. What time does the football match begin?
Aren’t you playing football this afternoon?
Yeah, Dad, I’m going to get my things in a minute.
But it’s already half past two.
I know, but we aren’t playing till half past three today – our teacher can’t get there till quarter past.
Oh, OK. We can leave home a bit later then.
Three. Which T-shirt would the boy like?
I love the picture on that T-shirt, Mum.
Oh, is that a lion on the front?
I mean the other one, with the skateboard on it. It’s over there, next to the one with the moon on it, look!
Yeah, I really like that. Shall we get it?
Yes, please!
Four. How much has the girl paid for each ticket?
I’ve got the tickets for the school concert!
Great – I’ll give you the money tomorrow – six pounds fifty, right?
That’s right. It’s good that my dad booked them online because you have to pay more on the day of the concert – they’re eight seventy-five then.
Two pounds twenty-five extra! That’s a lot!
Yeah, it is.
Five. Who did they have dinner with yesterday evening?
It was great last night. I love it when someone else joins us for dinner.
Yeah – it was nice to spend time with my classmate Ben!
By the way, who was that who picked him up afterwards? Was it his dad?
Actually, it was his grandad. I met him when I went to their house for dinner.
That is the end of Part One.
Now look at Part Two.
For each question, write the correct answer in the gap. Write one word or a number or a date or a time. Look at questions 6–10 now. You have 10 seconds.
You will hear a teacher talking to pupils about a school trip.

Right, I want to tell you about the school nature trip, which is on the 23rd of March. Now, when we asked you about the trip, a few people wanted to go to the river. But actually, the forest was even more popular. And we haven’t been before, so that’s where we’re going.
Our coach will leave school at 8:45, so please get here no later than 8:35. We don’t want anyone to be late please.
Now, you’ll need to think about what to wear. You’ll need a coat to keep warm. If you wear shorts or anything like that, I think you’ll be too cold.

We’ll have a guide. His name’s Dan Pilsey, and I’ll spell that: P-I-L-S-E-Y, because I’d like you to read about him online before we go. He made a great film about monkeys. You won’t see any of those but try to find some of the horses which live in the area. Now, any questions?
That is the end of Part Two.
Now look at Part Three.
For each question, choose the correct answer. Look at questions 11–15 now. You have 20 seconds.
You will hear two friends talking about their chess club.
I’m glad our teacher told us about chess club.
I already knew about it. My dad saw an ad in a magazine for it and said I should join.
What do you like about the club?
Well, the coach is really good.
And being in competitions is fun.
Only if you win, and I never do. Spending time with the other players is the best thing.
True.
Why didn’t you come last week?
I went to see grandma in hospital. She had a terrible headache but she’s home now. Tonight she’s helping me with my history homework.
Great.
Did you have a good time last week?
I played with Alex. I lost but it was a good game. I wanted to take some team photos, but unfortunately I left my mobile at home. I missed the bus and walked home.
Oh!
Are you coming next week?
Yes, and I’m going to the cinema afterwards. Would you like to come?
I have football then, but let’s have a sandwich at the café in the shopping centre before that.
OK.
That is the end of Part Three.
Now look at Part Four.
For each question, choose the correct answer.
Sixteen. You will hear a brother and sister talking. What does the girl want the boy to do?
I’m hungry. Shall we ask Mum if we can have a pizza?
OK, I’ve just got to finish my homework first.
Do you want help with it? I’m good at history.
Thanks, but it’s not hard. Pass me my phone. I’ll check my spelling, then I’ll be ready. I’d love some juice if you’re not doing anything...
OK, hold on a moment.
Seventeen. You will hear a girl talking to her teacher. What should the girl try to do in the future?
What do I need to get better at next term, Mr Howard?
You’ve worked very hard this term, Mary. Your homework’s always been done on time.
Thank you.
And you always say something interesting when we’re discussing things. But... sometimes it takes you a bit too long to finish an exercise.
OK, I’ll try to do something about that.
Eighteen. You will hear a girl talking about her new bag. Why did she choose this bag?
Is that a new bag?
Yes, do you like it? I wasn’t sure about getting a green one.
So, why did you get it?
It was the only one left and the discount was great. The colour’s not too bad, is it? Unfortunately, it’s slightly too small for my books. Maybe it’ll be OK for my swimming kit though.
Nineteen. You will hear a girl talking to her mother. Why does the girl want to give her jacket to her cousin?
Can I give my blue jacket to my cousin?
The one with the tiny pockets?
That’s right, I’ve grown since I got it. Soon it’ll look as if I’ve borrowed it from my little sister!
Don’t you like the colour?
I do. But I’d like to get a new one, probably the same colour though.
Twenty. You will hear a boy telling his mother about a geography lesson. What did he enjoy most about the lesson?
How was geography today, Nick?

Good. We watched a video about deserts. That was OK. Then we worked in groups to find out all we could about one particular desert. Ours was the Sahara. I drew a map and the others looked online for information. It was fun and I felt really proud because what I did looked great.
That is the end of Part Four.
Now look at Part Five.
For each question, choose the correct answer. Look at questions 21–25 now. You have 15 seconds.
You will hear a boy telling his sister about the activities his friends did at the weekend. What activity did each friend do?
All my friends were really busy this weekend!
What did Alec do?
He finished his school history project!
Great!
Angela did something more interesting. She’s in a band, so she practised all weekend. They use a room above a shop.
Oh yeah, she told me. And what about Marvin – doesn’t he usually go swimming at the weekend?
Yes, but this weekend he went away to stay with his granny and grandad, so he couldn’t.
What about Diane?
She had to go and choose a present for her dad’s birthday, so she went to a department store. She wanted to get him some cooking things.
Nice!
Gavin visited a castle. It was built in the 14th century, he said. And they were lucky, because there was a free jazz concert while they were there.
Yeah, he told me. What did Lucy do?
Her grandparents were staying at her house. She wanted to go to the swimming pool, but her grandmother wanted to play chess. So that’s what they did – the whole weekend!
That is the end of Part Five.
You now have six minutes to write your answers on the answer sheet.
You have one more minute.
That is the end of the test.
